title: Beautiful, but tight seat area.  Return nightmare!
text:
Beautiful, but tight seat area. Return nightmare!. The chair seating area is actually smaller than the 17.5"W and 17" depth in the description. The diameter of the seat pad is only 16.25" making the chair much smaller than the 17.25" diameter seats I am replacing. On the positive side, the chair went together easily enough. It looks great and the padding was comfortable. If the seat had just been that 1" extra in diameter, I would have given the item 5 stars.

RETURNING THEM is a nightmare so far! Each bar stool came in a separate box, but Amazon return gave only a single label for the return. The Amazon website has no way to contact customer service about this particular problem. My daughter found an 888 number for Amazon on Google, which connected to an overseas call center. I gave my name , my email address and my order number, but they insisted I had to also give my complete address before they could help me. Since I cannot guarantee that number is Amazon as it cannot be accessed through the Amazon website, I refused. Hence there was no help to be had. Figured a way around it but it will double the return shipping cost. (Shipping 5 back was $44+ shipping them back individually will be $77+)
